newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sets up telecom sale working group.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sets up telecom sale working group.

text.p: The Bulgarian cabinet decided on Monday to set up a new working group headed by two deputy prime ministers which will prepare the planned sale of a stake in the Bulgarian Telecommunications Company (BTC), officials said.

A government spokeswoman said representatives of the new administration had been appointed to replace members of the working group, who had been from the ex-communsit Socialist government, toppled in February after street protests.
Deputy Prime Ministers Evgeni Bakardzhiev and Alexander Bozhkov will head the working group.
BTC officials say Bulgaria has agreed with the IMF to sell a majority stake in the company.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has been chosen to advise Bulgaria in the BTC stake sale and Bulgaria is now awaiting the approval of the World Bank.

"We have sent the documents (the contract with Deutsche Morgan Grenfell) to the World Bank for approval," Alexander Sabotinov, executive director of the Privatisation Agency, told 24 Hours daily newspaper in an interview published on Monday.
Sabotinov said that whether the deal would be finalised next year depended on the foreign consultant.
He pointed out that during the same time when Bulgaria offers a BTC stake, its Balkan neighbours Romania, Greece and Turkey would be also on the market selling stakes in their telecom companies.
"This is a serious competition and should be carefully evaluated," Sabotinov said.
